rows.prompt: In the clinic supply closet, a person must sort a delayed request queue. They hold a clipboard, reviewing a long list of overdue items. A colleague offers a small, wrapped baked good; the person hesitates, then accepts it with a soft smile, their shoulders relaxing slightly as they pocket the treat before turning back to the bins.
